Advanced Healthcare Coordination Experience

The ACS/Trauma Nurse Navigator provides clinical care coordination for patients recovering from surgery and those requiring ongoing support through the ACS/Trauma Service. The ACS/Trauma Nurse Navigator is an RN with advanced skills who serves as a consistent care coordinator throughout the continuum of surgical and trauma care. They are responsible for assessing healthcare barriers and the physical, psychological, and social needs of the patient, providing them with educational, emotional, and social support. This role requires a dedicated person knowledgeable in the flow of events in post-surgical recovery, trauma care coordination, and the management of patients requiring additional surgical interventions. The ACS/Trauma Nurse Navigator is an individual trained to navigate patients through post-surgical recovery, coordinating care when patients are in need of additional support or require additional surgeries with the ACS/Trauma Service. The ACS/Trauma Nurse Navigator reports to the Nurse Manager and works closely with the ACS/Trauma Surgery leadership team to ensure delivery of appropriate and timely services to patients and other key stakeholders. The ACS/Trauma Nurse Navigator has primary responsibility for day-to-day care coordination throughout the entire pre-, intra- and post-operative interventions in order to support patients in their recovery after surgery. The ACS/Trauma Nurse Navigator acts as a mentor, preceptor, and resource for other Clinical Nurses (CN 1, 2 & 3) as well as other staff members. The ACS/Trauma Nurse Navigator, in conjunction with the ACS/Trauma surgery nursing leadership team, assists in procedure policy and procedure development and ongoing updates. This position also provides input to department leaders regarding workflows to enhance efficiency and patient care. Escalates clinical or personnel issues to AN 2 or Nurse Manager as appropriate.
